description: Gigabit broadband availability is a dataset listed in Westofenglandca open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Building Digital UK (BDUK). Building Digital UK (BDUK) leads the delivery of the UK Government's digital infrastructure programmes, forming part of the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT). These data outline whether, according to BDUK, each premises in the West of England region is capable of gigabit broadband connection. Coverage: West of England Combined Authority area. The portal files it under Digital. The portal shows 468,018 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-02-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL v.3 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-westofengland-ca-gov-uk-portal.
